scope: Read complete Japanese premises/exchanges and all12 target sentence/task sets. Metadata/native/device approval excluded.
reviewCriteria: Cash receipts missing from a bank deposit list are not zero; reconcile later deposits without double counting.
Payment remains outstanding while retrieving a wallet; one banknote, change, receipt and a final personal-belongings check are separate actions.
Hand over outstanding food orders and coordination to Sato; transfer to a companion does not settle the restaurant bill. Japanese Sato-san does not establish gender.
Only cancel the duplicate dish not yet being prepared; retain the other dish and unrelated orders.
